$description: Brand / Marketing design tokens — the external-facing identity system (logo, website, pitch, social, print, email). SEPARATE from the Product UI system (see design-tokens.json / DESIGN_SYSTEM.md). The two systems share only the green (Pulse = product green/500 = #18DD65). Source: AdvPulse Brand & Style Guide + brand-guidelines.md. Brand artifacts are hand-built, not Figma-variable-driven, so these are curated values, not a live token dump.

pulse.role: Signal / accent — used sparingly, one thing at a time

valid: Mist on Deep Teal (large sizes only)
invalid: Pulse on Paper (fails contrast; neon on white)
Deep Teal on Ink (the two darks never pair)

serif.role: Reserved — one signature hero line per surface (H1). Used with restraint. Never for section titles, sub-heads, running headings, or repeated labels.

sans.role: Workhorse — every heading below the hero, plus all body and UI.

mono.role: Labels, buttons, links, data. Always uppercase, positive tracking.

scale.note: At most once per surface; every other level is Plus Jakarta Sans.

primary.use: Default — website header, decks, signage, wide formats
primary.clearSpace: height of the globe on all sides

secondary.use: Square / vertical spaces — social tiles, app stores, narrow columns

misuse: Pulse on Paper / Paper on Pulse (neon and white never sit on each other)
Deep Teal on Ink / Ink on Deep Teal (the two darks never sit together)
